intro.uz: Bu — suzish murabbiyi Feruza haqida qisqa tarjimai hol. Oʻqishdan oldin: sizning sevimli sport turingiz qaysi?

paragraphs.en: Feruza Aliyeva is a swimming coach. She is thirty-five years old and she lives in Namangan. She works at the city sports centre.
paragraphs.uz: Feruza Aliyeva — suzish murabbiyi. U oʻttiz besh yoshda va Namanganda yashaydi. U shahar sport markazida ishlaydi.

paragraphs.en: Feruza loves water. At the age of seven, she could swim very well. Now she has got forty students. They are from six to sixty years old!
paragraphs.uz: Feruza suvni yaxshi koʻradi. Yetti yoshidayoq u juda yaxshi suza olardi. Hozir uning qirqta shogirdi bor. Ular olti yoshdan oltmish yoshgacha!

paragraphs.en: Feruza's day starts early. She gets up at five and runs in the park. Her first lesson is at seven. She has lunch at one and finishes work at six.
paragraphs.uz: Feruzaning kuni erta boshlanadi. U soat beshda turadi va bogʻda yuguradi. Birinchi darsi soat yettida. U soat birda tushlik qiladi va ishni soat oltida tugatadi.

paragraphs.en: Feruza is a kind but strict coach. She always tells her students: never swim alone, and always drink water after a lesson.
paragraphs.uz: Feruza mehribon, lekin talabchan murabbiy. U shogirdlariga doim aytadi: hech qachon yolgʻiz suzmang va darsdan keyin doim suv iching.
